The '''2005–06 [[Super League Greece|Alpha Ethniki]]''' was the 70th season of the highest [[Association football|football]] league of Greece and the last season under the name ''Alpha Ethniki'', before then was renamed to ''Super League Greece''. The season began on 27 August 2005 and ended on 13 May 2006. [[Olympiacos F.C.|Olympiacos]] won their second consecutive and 34th Greek title. However, the season was somewhat overshadowed by the suspension of the Greek FA by [[UEFA]],<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.uefa.com/uefa/Keytopics/kind=64/newsId=433810.html |title=Greece suspended by FIFA |publisher=[[UEFA]] |access-date=2013-04-15 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20060705005153/http://www.uefa.com/uefa/Keytopics/kind%3D64/newsId%3D433810.html |archive-date=2006-07-05 }}</ref> which jeopardized the European places of the [[UEFA Champions League|Champions League]], [[UEFA Europa League|UEFA Cup]], and [[UEFA Intertoto Cup|Intertoto Cup]] qualifiers from Greece, as well as the use of [[Athens Olympic Stadium]] as the site of the [[2006–07 UEFA Champions League|2006–07 Champions League]] final.
